messages:
jenny-support: FYI customer (AcmeCorp) on Private deployment is seeing intermittent ECONNRESET during streaming after ~5-10m idle. They report TLS handshake OK but stream drops with RST. Customer env: VPC w/ SG + NACL + NAT GW. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d. Can someone triage?

mike-eng: Can you paste a small tcpdump from the inference node around the failure? Also which model route and port?

jenny-support: repro snippet from customer (redacted):
```
19:04:12.345678 IP 10.0.5.12.443 > 10.0.8.21.54321: Flags [P.], seq 1:512, ack 1, win 64240
19:09:15.987654 IP 10.0.8.21.54321 > 10.0.5.12.443: Flags [RST], seq 42, ack 512, win 0
```
They also sent `netstat -anp | grep 443` showing sockets in ESTABLISHED briefly then RST.

mike-eng: that RST looks client-originated. Two quick suspects: (1) NACL is stateless and missing ephemeral return-port allowance so NAT/port mapping broken after idle; (2) an edge firewall or WAF doing TLS inspection + connection reuse causing server/client to disagree and reset.

alex-sre: Also check for any stateful device between their NAT and our host that has an idle timeout shorter than keepalive. AWS ALBs have ~350s idle timeout default for TCP? If they have a custom appliance with 300s timeout that would kill idle streaming.

jenny-support: Customer says issue happens around 5-10 minutes consistently. Their ops team ran `ss -tanp | grep 443` and saw periodic keepalive probes then immediate RST from the remote IP.

pat-ops: Quick repro steps I asked them to run:
1) curl long-poll simulate: `curl -v --no-buffer https://private-infer.internal/stream/test`
2) run tcpdump `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <our-host-ip> and port 443 -w dump.pcap`
3) enable verbose TLS logs on client: `openssl s_client -connect <host>:443 -ign_eof -tlsextdebug`

mike-eng: Based on timing, try these mitigation checks:
- Ensure their NACL inbound/outbound rules include ephemeral port range (1024-65535) for return traffic so NAT can rebind ports properly.
- If using a stateful firewall, prefer allowing ESTABLISHED,RELATED or increase idle timeout to >15m.
- On the client side enable TCP keepalive or lower keepalive interval so middleboxes do not consider the connection idle.

jenny-support: I asked them to add a temporary NACL rule to allow outbound ephemeral range and to extend firewall idle to 20m, they will test in 30min.

infra-bot: Ticket #INC-4521 created and linked to support case r-0a1b2c3d.

alex-sre: If problem persists after their change, grab AWS Flow Logs for the ENI + NAT GW to see if RST originates before or after NAT. Also check if their on-prem FW rewrites source ports on return.

mike-eng: Workaround for customer if they can't change infra quickly: enable application-level keepalives (client send small ping every 60s) and add our retry-on-rst backoff in the SDK to reconnect gracefully and resume the stream. We'll draft a KB entry.

jenny-support: Customer tested change: after allowing ephemeral range on NACL AND increasing appliance idle timeout to 25m, no resets in 45m stress test. They will roll to prod. Closing unless any objections.

pat-ops: Please follow up with KB steps + NACL snippets we recommended.

mike-eng: ACK, I'll draft the KB and include recommended tcpdump checks and sample NACL rules.
